entities.summary: Hanser Joel Alberto Peña is a Dominican former professional baseball infielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Texas Rangers, Baltimore Orioles, Kansas City Royals, Los Angeles Dodgers, and Chicago White Sox.
